# Taste Skill

- Upstream: `https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill`
- Purpose: frontend/UI design quality, stronger layout, typography, spacing, and motion.
- Preferred install name for GPT/Codex: `gpt-taste`.
- Role in D-AI-Hub: implementation/design-quality layer used alongside, not instead of, development process skills.
- Installation: install through the supported Agent Skills mechanism for the target harness; do not vendor upstream code here by default.
- Compatibility: repository provides GPT/Codex-oriented and general variants.
- Pinning: record a version/commit if a project depends on exact visual behavior.
- Local modifications: none.
